intro.title: Full-Stack Developer, Secure by Design
intro.text: I build software that's secure by design, not secured as an afterthought. I'm a junior full-stack developer (React, Java/Spring Boot, Django) with a Master's in Information Systems & Infrastructure Security, and I ship features through CI/CD pipelines with security testing built in. Open to full-stack roles and to relocation.

cards.description: Platform that uses AI to generate security audit reports automatically, built during my end-of-studies internship at SOTETEL. Role-based access control across 4 user roles, and a CI/CD pipeline running Snyk (SAST), OWASP ZAP (DAST) and Trivy (container scanning) on every commit. Technologies: React, TypeScript, Django, PostgreSQL, Docker, Nginx, GitHub Actions

Centralized log management system that monitors server activity in real time. I configured automated email alerts triggered by critical events, such as SSH brute-force attempts and other suspicious activity. Technologies: Graylog, Linux, Networking
Interactive football quiz game where players compete by answering football questions. Built from scratch, with a clean design and dynamic gameplay. Technologies: React, Python, GitHub
Intelligent system that detects available parking spots in captured images, using a deep learning model trained to identify free spaces. Technologies: Python, OpenCV

Web application for managing a veterinary clinic's invoices, client records and consultations, with an online appointment booking system. Hosted and deployed on Hostinger, with continuous maintenance and improvements. Technologies: React, Laravel, MySQL, Git

E-commerce platform that automates orders and improves the customer experience, with an NLP module that personalises product recommendations. Technologies: React, Laravel, MongoDB, Flask, scikit-learn, Git
Performance analysis of Lionel Messi against Real Betis, presented through dynamic, responsive visualisations. Technologies: Python
Web application displaying Euro 2024 statistics in real time. Technologies: Python, Streamlit
Player performance rating model based on statistical criteria, with results presented in a clear visual table. Technologies: Python, Pandas, scikit-learn, Matplotlib
Restaurant interface based on the "Little Lemon" challenge, with menu, reservation and contact pages. Focused on responsive design and modular components. Technologies: React, CSS
Cinema seat reservation app with an interactive interface for choosing and booking seats, using JavaScript and the DOM for the logic and dynamic display. Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript

cards.description:
Built an AI-assisted platform that automates security audit report generation, validated in a production-like setup with 5 users.
Secured access for 4 user roles with RBAC and role-based data isolation across the REST API.
Embedded security testing into every commit with a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline: SAST (Snyk), DAST (OWASP ZAP) and container scanning (Trivy).
Containerised and deployed the platform with Docker and Nginx.
Technologies: React, TypeScript, Django, PostgreSQL, Docker, Nginx, GitHub Actions

Delivered a complete veterinary management platform to production in under 2 months: invoices, client records and consultations.
Built an online appointment booking system for the clinic's clients.
Digitised billing for 72 consultations per day; the platform was used daily by the clinic for one year.
Hosted and deployed on Hostinger, with bug fixes, performance improvements and new features throughout the engagement.
Technologies: React, Laravel, MySQL, Git

Built a complete e-commerce platform end to end to automate orders and improve the customer experience.
Integrated an NLP module (scikit-learn, Flask API) to personalise product recommendations.
Delivered over 8 Agile sprints with weekly reviews and Git-based code review.
Technologies: React, Laravel, MongoDB, Flask, scikit-learn, Git

Organization.sotetel: SOTETEL (Société Tunisienne d'Entreprises de Télécommunications) is a Tunisian telecommunications engineering and infrastructure company, listed on the Tunis Stock Exchange.
Organization.medianet: MEDIANET is a Tunisian agency specialising in digital marketing and digital transformation. Founded in 1998, it helps businesses in Tunisia and internationally with their digitalisation.
Organization.medicapet: MedicaPet is a veterinary clinic in La Marsa, Tunisia, offering internal medicine, surgery, vaccination and emergency care for pets. Its veterinarians are graduates of the National School of Veterinary Medicine of Sidi Thabet.
